name: 2one-brand-logo
title: 2one logo
description: Brand wordmark. Use for brand identification only — not a decorative asset, not a generic image placeholder. Do not scale, recolor, rotate, or add effects beyond the Fill variants provided.

rules.clearSpace: 0.5x the logo height on all sides

howToChoose: On a light or white surface use variant 'black'. On a dark surface use variant 'white'. Never place black on dark or white on light.

variants.usage: Black wordmark — use on light/white backgrounds.
White wordmark — use on dark backgrounds.

react.note: No color prop by design — the brand rule forbids recoloring.
